findings.reason: this bar is the only quality threshold the plan has and the lead is asked to confirm it with the model answer, so leaving it passable at 36 partly-right in 40 retires the gate at the moment the model choice is made, not after.
findings.text: section 6's quality bar fails only on "at most four of the forty are wrong", so a run whose other thirty-six descriptions are all scored partly right passes, and because the plan defines neither the boundary between partly right and wrong nor a ceiling on partly right, the classifier's discretion decides the verdict with no failing observation
